name: Paused Stopwatch
text: If this card is still in your hand when the tenth trick begins, gain +25 contract value.
timing: While in hand (checkpoint at the tenth trick)

signature.trigger: the tenth trick begins with this card in your hand

archetypes: While Held; splash Exact Contractor, Gold Miner
decision: Whether to keep this card back through the middle of the round, even when playing it would win or shed a trick you'd like to.
opponent: Opponents can lead its suit repeatedly to force it out early.
aiNote: Play this card only when it's your last card of the suit led and no other legal play exists, until the tenth trick.
rationale: Holding one card through nine tricks succeeds about 60–70% of the time, so it pays about +15 EV, the common budget; it is the common step below Patient Hourglass (DU-S10, last trick, +1×) and checks the same tenth trick as Measured Delta (BL-U10).
deviation: Redesigned from a permission to play off suit when your only cards of the suit led had sigils, which was complicated and rarely mattered.
